NATIONAL WATER SUPPLY AND DRAINAGE BOARD ACT, No. 02 OF 1974
Order under Section 92

BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 92 of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, No. 02 of 1974,I, Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of Urban Development Water Supply and Drainage, do hereby approve the acquisition of theimmovable property, described in the following schedule, as it is required by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board,for the construction of the Main Pumphouse under Kandy Wastewater Management Project.
RAUFF HAKEEM, Minister of Urban Development,
Water Supply and Drainage.Ministry of Water Supply and Drainage,No. 35, ‘Lakdiya Medura’New Parliament Road,Pelawatta, Battaramulla,04th June, 2015.5/2/1/1125
SCHEDULE

Two allotments of land called Bogahayatapela situated at Wel Ata Village in the Grama Niladhari Division of Mulgampolain the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kandy and Gangawata Korale in Kandy District and containing in extent of about13.85 Perches (Lot No. 6 of Plan No. 1771 A) and bounded as follows :–

North - East:Lot No. 4 of the same Plan (Walauwewatta alias Bogahapelessa and Bomaluwa Kumbura) andLot No. 7 of the same Plan ;South - East:Part of Lot No. 7C in Plan No. 2938 by J. C. Jonklass Licensed Surveyor ;South - West:Lot No. 14 and 15 in P. Plan No. Maha 3859 ;North - West:Lot No. 5 and 3 of the same Plan.
Name and address of the claimant :1.Mr. Mahinda Katugaha,No. 39/4 - 13/3, Rajapihilla Mawatha,Katugasthota,Kandy.
